pre_scorer: ORI automated drafting agent (pre-score; not a human review)
note: Pre-scores only for Virginia units whose text ORI fetched (13VAC5-63-210 items 62-64). No determinations were searched for Chapter 6; evidence_strength is none_found by construction. Two independent human reviewers are needed.

urn:ori:rule-unit:irc2021-va:R602.10.rationale: The official may require braced wall lines and analysis on the drawings; when that power is used, and what analysis suffices, is left to the official.
intent_questions: What bracing documentation triggers the official's request?

urn:ori:rule-unit:irc2021-va:R602.12.2:p.rationale: Numeric minimum lengths keyed to wall height and opening height; interpolation is permitted between listed values.

urn:ori:rule-unit:irc2021-va:R602.12.3:p.rationale: The numeric limits are clear, but which projections a rectangle must enclose depends on terms such as partial height projections.

ambiguous_terms.issue: Which projections count as partial height is not measured; a reviewer decides whether a bay or porch is inside the rectangle.

urn:ori:rule-unit:irc2021-va:R602.12.6:p.rationale: A single numeric limit measured from building or rectangle corners.

urn:ori:rule-unit:irc2021-va:R602.12.4.2.rationale: Exterior panels count at actual length and interior panels at half; the required length comes from the applicant's table lookup.
